_note: G1 practice test questions. `answer` is the 0-based index of the correct option. `sign` draws a sign above the question: "stop", "yield" or "" for none. passMark = minimum correct answers for the 'Great job' message.

questions.q: What must you do at this sign?
options: Slow down and continue if clear
Come to a complete stop, then go when safe
Stop only if other cars are coming
questions.why: A red octagon is a STOP sign. Always come to a complete stop at the line.

options: Let traffic with the right-of-way go first
questions.why: The upside-down triangle is a YIELD sign: slow down or stop and let others go first.

questions.q: As a G1 driver, your blood alcohol level must be:
questions.why: G1 and G2 drivers must have a blood alcohol level of zero.

questions.q: A school bus ahead has red lights flashing on a road with no median. You must:
options: Stop, whether you are behind it or coming toward it
questions.why: On roads without a median, traffic in both directions must stop.

questions.q: Unless signs say otherwise, the speed limit in Ontario cities and towns is:
questions.why: The default limit in cities, towns and villages is 50 km/h.

questions.q: A G1 driver must drive with a fully licensed driver who has at least:
questions.why: Your accompanying driver needs at least 4 years of driving experience.
